useful_god.rationale: Day Master Wood is strong; Fire balances the chart.

yogas.name: Gaja-Kesari
yogas.reason: Jupiter is in the 7th sign from the Moon.

yogas.name: Budha-Aditya
yogas.reason: Sun is in Cancer and Mercury in Leo; Budha-Aditya needs both in the same sign.

yogas.name: Chandra-Mangala
yogas.reason: Moon is in Sagittarius and Mars in Virgo; Chandra-Mangala needs both in the same sign.

yogas.name: Ruchaka
yogas.reason: Mars is in Virgo, neither its own sign (Aries, Scorpio) nor its exaltation sign (Capricorn).

yogas.name: Bhadra
yogas.reason: Mercury is in Leo, neither its own sign (Gemini, Virgo) nor its exaltation sign (Virgo).

yogas.name: Hamsa
yogas.reason: Jupiter is in Gemini, neither its own sign (Sagittarius, Pisces) nor its exaltation sign (Cancer).

yogas.name: Malavya
yogas.reason: Venus is in Leo, neither its own sign (Taurus, Libra) nor its exaltation sign (Pisces).

yogas.name: Sasa
yogas.reason: Saturn is in its own sign Aquarius but in the 3rd house from the Lagna; Sasa needs a kendra (1st, 4th, 7th or 10th house).

yogas.name: Harsha
yogas.reason: The 6th house is Taurus; its lord Venus is in the 9th house; Harsha needs the 6th, 8th or 12th.

yogas.name: Sarala
yogas.reason: The 8th house is Cancer; its lord Moon is in the 1st house; Sarala needs the 6th, 8th or 12th.

yogas.name: Vimala
yogas.reason: The 12th house is Scorpio; its lord Mars is in the 10th house; Vimala needs the 6th, 8th or 12th.

yogas.name: Neecha Bhanga
yogas.reason: No planet is in its debilitation sign.

yogas.name: Sunapha
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Moon (Capricorn): none; 12th from the Moon (Scorpio): none (Sun, Rahu and Ketu do not count).

yogas.name: Anapha
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Moon (Capricorn): none; 12th from the Moon (Scorpio): none (Sun, Rahu and Ketu do not count).

yogas.name: Durudhara
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Moon (Capricorn): none; 12th from the Moon (Scorpio): none (Sun, Rahu and Ketu do not count).

yogas.name: Kemadruma
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Moon (Capricorn): none; 12th from the Moon (Scorpio): none (Sun, Rahu and Ketu do not count); Kemadruma means both are empty. It is cancelled (Kemadruma Bhanga): Mars and Jupiter in a kendra from the Moon (1st, 4th, 7th or 10th sign).

yogas.name: Vesi
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Sun (Leo): Mercury and Venus; 12th from the Sun (Gemini): Jupiter (Moon, Rahu and Ketu do not count).

yogas.name: Vasi
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Sun (Leo): Mercury and Venus; 12th from the Sun (Gemini): Jupiter (Moon, Rahu and Ketu do not count).

yogas.name: Ubhayachari
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Sun (Leo): Mercury and Venus; 12th from the Sun (Gemini): Jupiter (Moon, Rahu and Ketu do not count).

yogas.name: Subha Kartari
yogas.reason: Natural benefics (Jupiter, Venus, Mercury) in the 2nd house: none; in the 12th: none. Subha Kartari needs both houses occupied by them (the Moon is not counted).

yogas.name: Papa Kartari
yogas.reason: Natural malefics (Sun, Mars, Saturn, Rahu, Ketu) in the 2nd house: none; in the 12th: Ketu. Papa Kartari needs both houses occupied by them (the Moon is not counted).

yogas.name: Parivartana
yogas.reason: No two planets stand in each other's signs.

yogas.name: Mangal Dosha
yogas.reason: Mars is 10th from the Lagna, 10th from the Moon and 2nd from Venus; the dosha houses are the 1st, 2nd, 4th, 7th, 8th and 12th.

yogas.name: Kala Sarpa
yogas.reason: Planets lie on both sides of the Rahu–Ketu axis: Sun, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter and Venus on one, Moon and Saturn on the other.

yogas.name: Amala
yogas.reason: Natural benefics (Jupiter, Venus, Mercury) in the 10th from the Lagna (Virgo): none; in the 10th from the Moon (Virgo): none.

yogas.name: Dhana
yogas.reason: The 2nd lord Saturn and the 11th lord Venus are linked: Saturn in Aquarius and Venus in Leo aspect each other.

yogas.name: Dharma-Karmadhipati
yogas.reason: The 9th lord Sun (Cancer) and the 10th lord Mercury (Leo) share no sign, mutual aspect or sign exchange.

yogas.name: Nakshatra Parivartana
yogas.reason: Mercury is in a nakshatra ruled by Ketu and Ketu in one ruled by Mercury.
